nyid pa mthong lam yan chad na yod cing de man chad na med de lam mtshan nyid pa med pas 
so || de yang rgyud bla ma las dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis || lam gyi bden pa 
yang dag bshad || dag sogs gsum ni nyi bzhin no || zhes gsungs pa dang*|_lam gyi 
bden pa 'khor dang bcas pa lam lnga yin no zhes pa'i gtso bo mthong sgom*yin* pa dang*|
sbyor lam lam gsum gyi rgyur bshad pa'i phyir ro zhes so || </seg></TEI>
